mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping carries the full source chain: units passing through multiple handlers (state); a per-event ledger of party, time and purpose inspected transition by transition (operation); continuity versus gaps and contradictions (signal); continuity supporting identity and handling-history claims while breaks weaken only dependent claims (inference). All three source limits are carried explicitly: complete records do not prove truthful recording, missing records do not prove alteration, and strength depends on recording reliability. The material divergence is in who makes the record. In the source, handlers record events at the time of handling. Here the investigator assembles the ledger retrospectively, and most compositional lines are reconstructed from physical traces. The mapping discloses this, tags each line by record type and grades claims accordingly, so the warrant is not silently substituted. Whether the custody warrant actually operates depends on unresolved target facts: whether contemporaneous records exist for the post-compositional phase, and whether trace-derived lines can be dated or attributed independently of the sequence they are used to support. The mapping itself lists the existence of accession or provenance files as an unsettled assumption.

target_fidelity.rationale: The inference answers both halves of the retained question. It offers a sequence of revision and assembly (the candidate leaving the fewest breaks and contradictions, reported step by step with evidential grade). It identifies which claims remain uncertain (claims graded as reconstructed-from-trace or unsupported across a break, with competing sequences retained at each break). The contribution is explicitly bounded: present and narrative order are not taken as composition order without independent linkage, and a local mark is not taken to establish a whole composition history. The custody mechanism in its strictest form (the post-compositional ledger) addresses a precondition, namely whether the examined arrangement is the one the author left. That is used as an input to the original question, not as a replacement for it.

operational_coherence.rationale: The chain is intelligible: building the ledger yields unit-level observations of continuity or break (superseded numbering resolving into a sequence, text running across leaf boundaries, stock/ink/hand consistency, agreement with dated records), and these warrant graded, bounded claims. Two empirical relations remain unestablished. First, for reconstructed lines the mapping concedes they 'rest on interpretation of the same features they are used to order'. Unless trace features can be tied to handling events by evidence independent of the proposed ordering (externally dated paper stock, hands matched to exemplars, dated correspondence), continuity in the compositional ledger is partly an artefact of how the ledger was built. Second, selecting the 'best' sequence by fewest breaks is an added rule not present in the source. It needs break counts to track explanatory adequacy, not differential record survival or the chosen unit segmentation. The inference is not incoherent, because contemporaneous records and convergence across independent feature classes can supply a non-circular check. But that must be shown on the actual material, and no observations have been made.

unresolved_conditions: Existence and coverage of contemporaneous records for the post-compositional phase (accession registers, sale catalogues, conservation reports, provenance files). Establish by surveying the holding institution's accession and conservation files and sale records, and determining which present-state features (foliation, binding, order) they account for.

Independence of trace-derived ledger lines from the sequence hypothesis. Establish by dating or attributing paper stock, watermarks, ink layers and hands from evidence external to the draft's proposed order (dated exemplars, dated correspondence, stock usage elsewhere), and by testing whether independent feature classes converge on the same relative order.

Separability of authorial from non-authorial or post-compositional change (foliation hands, markings, imposed order). Establish by hand comparison against identified exemplars and by documented archival foliation and sorting practices for the collection.

Basic material facts the mapping lists as unsettled: number of surviving witnesses, whether the draft is manuscript, typescript or mixed, and how many hands are present. Establish by physical inventory and collation before the ledger is opened.

Discriminating power of the fewest-breaks criterion. Establish by checking that candidate assembly sequences differ at transitions supported by independently graded evidence, and that the ranking is stable under alternative unit segmentation and is not driven by uneven record survival.
validity.rationale: No criterion fails. The mapping preserves the source's state→operation→signal→inference chain and carries its limits, including an explicit statement that the inference is weaker here than in the source practice. The inference addresses the retained question as a graded, bounded contribution. However, the custody warrant depends on a recording process whose reliability and independence are not established for this target. The packet supplies no evidence, the existence of contemporaneous archival records is unknown, and most compositional entries would be investigator reconstructions from the same traces used to order the units. These are identifiable measurements and empirical relations that could be established on the material, not a known mechanism loss, so the transfer is Conditional, not Valid or Invalid.

uncertainty: The packet's target evidence is empty and the mapping states that no observations have been made, so every signal is hypothetical and no ledger has been tested against a real draft.

It is unknown whether any contemporaneous custody records exist. If none do, the ledger is wholly reconstructed and the source warrant is reduced to trace interpretation. I cannot determine from the packet which case holds.
The degree of circularity in reconstructed-from-trace lines cannot be assessed without knowing whether external dating or attribution evidence is available for the paper, ink and hands.
The fewest-breaks selection rule is an addition not present in the source instrument. It is a reasonable explanatory criterion, but its reliability in this domain is assumed, not shown.

The mapping notes that its baseline practitioner description is an authored hypothesis and not verified consensus, so how closely it matches established bibliographical or genetic-critical practice is not confirmed by the packet.

The boundary between conditionally-preserved and not-preserved is a judgment call for the compositional ledger, where the recorder is the investigator and not a handler. I treated the explicit record-type tagging and downgraded grading as retaining the source warrant's logic instead of substituting it.
